summary: Landmark data with size information for single clades are on Dryad (crow beak shape, parrotfish allometry, lizard ecomorphs), and MorphoSource has scans for some groups, but the claim needs landmark and discrete-character data for the same species, which would come from MorphoBank. MorphoBank returned HTTP 403 to my client, so I could not check its matrices.
next_step: Open MorphoBank in a browser to see which projects carry both continuous and discrete characters for one clade, or choose a clade where a Dryad landmark set and a published character matrix cover the same species, then define the partition rule before testing.
obstacles_confirmed: Well-sampled clades are a minority of classes and genera.
